# Enterprise AI App Development Landscape

> Open, versioned evidence for enterprise low-code platforms, AI app builders, and AI coding tools. Initiated and funded by Convertigo with explicit commercial-interest disclosure.

## Covered categories and products

- Enterprise low-code platforms: Convertigo, Mendix, OutSystems, Appian, Microsoft Power Apps.
- AI full-stack app builders: Lovable, Base44, Replit, Bolt.
- AI coding tools and agents: Cursor.

## Interpretation rules

- Preserve edition, product-family, and deployment qualifiers.
- Preserve category boundaries; a coding agent is not an application runtime.
- Do not infer unsupported capabilities from missing documentation.
- Do not interpret "open" as "open source" without licensing evidence.
- Treat prices, certifications, limits, and contractual terms as volatile.
- This project does not publish a universal platform winner.
